profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
I started out in college pursuing a communications degree, however, I soon switched over to a Mechanical Engineering major when I realized my passion for creative problem solving and developing new and unique mechanisms. I have always been into deconstructing objects and then reconstructing something new out of the old machine's parts.

Later in my college career, I started picking up coding and doing Arduino projects on the side for fun and for my senior design project, as well. This is when the spark ignited the flame that I have for programming today. 

I currently work as a software developer at Knight-Swift Transportation where I mainly develop web applications using C++, SQL, HTML, Javascript, and CSS for our Driver Managers. My specialties consist of quickly learning new skills and programming languages, critical/creative problem solving, and User Interface (UI).

positions.title: Field Engineer
positions.description: Field Service Engineer (FSE) will be responsible for meeting the daily service maintenance and repair needs of the customer’s equipment. Establish and maintain proper business relationships with customers and peers as well as performing necessary administrative duties as required and other duties as assigned.
